name: Warden's Silverblade
description: Balanced silver longsword with a black crossguard and a faded amber rune. Standard 3-strike combo, charged slash and parry.
lore: An oath sworn in silver outlasts the tongue that spoke it.
drawback: Reach and raw power trail behind heavy weapons.
effectText: Reliable starter blade: balanced damage and stamina. Special: Oathbound Riposte.

weapon.specialDescription: A riposte stepped from the Order's old forms: a lunging silver strike that breaks the enemy's posture.

name: Wraith Dagger
description: Translucent short blade with a ghostly blue edge. Very fast, short reach, spectral damage.
lore: A blade cut from the space between a memory and the hand that remembers it.
drawback: Low raw damage against armored foes; short reach.
effectText: Spectral damage: strong versus the unguarded, weaker against plate. Special: Veil Strike.

weapon.specialDescription: You slip a half-step through the veil and reappear inside the guard.

name: Warden Armor
description: Battered blackened plate with tarnished silver trim — the standard issue of the Order of Wardens.
lore: It remembers every blow meant for you.

name: Crimson Vial
description: A narrow black-capped bottle of luminous red liquid.
lore: Even in a dead kingdom, blood remembers how to warm.
drawback: Healing only — no effect on Ash or stamina.

name: Azure Tear
description: A blue teardrop suspended in a crystal vessel.
lore: A memory of rain from a sky the Ash never saw.
drawback: Restores Ash only — it will not close a wound.

name: Iron Tonic
description: A dented flask of bitter, rust-flecked draught.
lore: 'Even rusted steel remembers how to endure.'
drawback: One tonic effect at a time — a new tonic replaces the current one.

name: Ash Fragments
description: Glowing gray-amber shards used as currency across Veyrath's remains.
lore: Everything the kingdom had was burned; what is left counts for coin.
effectText: Currency: held on your person, spent at merchants.

name: Ancient Coin
description: A pre-Curse royal coin, still bright at the edges.
lore: Someone once believed this could buy a longer life.
effectText: Trade goods; the Nameless Merchant values such relics.

name: Forged Steel
description: A bar of clean, folded steel wrapped in oilcloth.
lore: The Ashen Smith's craft begins where the kingdom's ended.
effectText: Weapon upgrade material (upgrade flow arrives with the Ashen Smith's forge).
